# Kezza Hair & Skin Clinic

> Doctor-led hair restoration, skin and laser care, permanent makeup and non-surgical body contouring clinic in Rajasthan, India, with three clinics: Jaipur (Khatipura, flagship), Sikar and Ajmer. All clinics are open 9 AM to 8 PM, all 7 days.

Official website: https://www.kezza.co.in/ · Main phone and WhatsApp: +91-9284517427 · Email: support@kezza.co.in · Legal name: Kezza Hair and Skin Clinic Private Limited · Founder and managing director: Pawan Bhalothia.
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/kezza_clinic · Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/kezzaclinic · YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@Kezza_Clinic_Jaipur

## Hair treatments
- [Hair Services](https://www.kezza.co.in/hair-services.html): all hair treatments: transplant, PRP, GFC, electrolysis, hair systems and wigs, hair-loss consultation
- [Hair Transplant](https://www.kezza.co.in/hair-transplant/): doctor-led surgery at all three clinics; FUE, DHI, beard and eyebrow transplant
- [FUE Hair Transplant](https://www.kezza.co.in/hair-transplant/fue/): follicle-by-follicle extraction with no linear scar (Jaipur, Sikar, Ajmer)
- [DHI Hair Transplant](https://www.kezza.co.in/hair-transplant/dhi/): implanter-pen placement for hairlines and dense packing (Jaipur)
- [Beard Transplant](https://www.kezza.co.in/hair-transplant/beard/): beard, moustache and sideburn restoration with the patient's own hair
- [Eyebrow Transplant](https://www.kezza.co.in/hair-transplant/eyebrow/): single-hair grafts to rebuild thin or over-plucked brows
- [हेयर ट्रांसप्लांट (Hindi)](https://www.kezza.co.in/hi/hair-transplant/): Hindi-language guide to hair transplant at Kezza
- [PRP Hair Treatment](https://www.kezza.co.in/prp-therapy.html): platelet-rich plasma injections for thinning hair
- [GFC Hair Treatment](https://www.kezza.co.in/gfc-treatment/): growth factor concentrate injections for thinning hair (Jaipur and Sikar)
- [Hair Loss Consultation](https://www.kezza.co.in/hair-loss-consultation.html): trichoscopy scalp assessment, Norwood staging and a treatment plan for hair fall
- [White & Grey Hair Removal](https://www.kezza.co.in/white-hair-removal.html): electrolysis for white, grey and blonde hair that laser cannot treat
- [Electrolysis](https://www.kezza.co.in/electrolysis.html): permanent removal of individual hairs of any colour, on any skin type
- [Hair Replacement (Wig & Patch)](https://www.kezza.co.in/hair-wig.html): custom non-surgical hair patches and wigs

## Skin treatments
- [Skin Services](https://www.kezza.co.in/skin-services.html): acne and scars, pigmentation, dark circles, anti-ageing, Botox, fillers, facials, glutathione, laser
- [Laser Hair Removal](https://www.kezza.co.in/laser-hair-removal/): triple-wavelength laser hair reduction for face and body (Jaipur and Sikar)
- [Acne Treatment](https://www.kezza.co.in/acne-treatment/): doctor-led treatment for active acne: medicines, peels and skin care (Jaipur, Sikar and Ajmer)
- [Hydra Facial](https://www.kezza.co.in/hydra-facial/): multi-step medical hydra facial (Jaipur, Sikar and Ajmer)
- [Botox & Dermal Fillers](https://www.kezza.co.in/botox/): botulinum toxin injections for expression lines and hyaluronic acid fillers for lost volume (Jaipur, Sikar and Ajmer)
- [Dark Circles Treatment](https://www.kezza.co.in/dark-circles-treatment/): cause-based treatment of under-eye dark circles (Jaipur, Sikar and Ajmer)
- [Pigmentation & Melasma Treatment](https://www.kezza.co.in/pigmentation-treatment/): prescription creams, chemical peels and laser toning for melasma and dark spots (Jaipur, Sikar and Ajmer)

- [Q-Switch Laser](https://www.kezza.co.in/q-switch-laser/): Q-switched Nd:YAG laser for pigmentation, laser toning and ink at ₹4,000 per session, usually 6 sessions per condition, by Dr. Neelam Choudhary (Jaipur and Sikar)
- [Full Body Laser Hair Removal](https://www.kezza.co.in/laser-hair-removal/full-body/): full body laser hair reduction at ₹4,000 per session, usually about 10 sessions, supervised by Dr. Amrita Mukhija and Dr. Neelam Choudhary (Jaipur and Sikar)
- [Chemical Peel](https://www.kezza.co.in/chemical-peel/): doctor-chosen superficial peels at ₹2,500 per session, usually a course of 3, by Dr. Amrita Mukhija and Dr. Neelam Choudhary (Jaipur and Sikar)
- [Medical Peel](https://www.kezza.co.in/medical-peel/): doctor-prescribed peels for melasma, stubborn pigmentation and acne marks at ₹5,000 per monthly session, plan as advised by the consultant (Jaipur and Sikar)
- [Microneedling](https://www.kezza.co.in/microneedling/): collagen induction for acne scars, pores and texture at ₹5,000 per session, 3 sessions 21 days apart, by Dr. Neelam Choudhary and Dr. Amrita Mukhija (Jaipur and Sikar)
- [Glutathione Treatment](https://www.kezza.co.in/glutathione-treatment/): doctor-assessed glutathione course at ₹4,000 per session (usually 10); the page explains the limited evidence and safety warnings (Jaipur and Sikar)
- [Skin Consultation](https://www.kezza.co.in/skin-consultation/): a doctor's assessment and treatment plan for any skin concern (Jaipur, Sikar and Ajmer)

## Weight Loss treatments

- [Blepharoplasty](https://www.kezza.co.in/blepharoplasty/): upper and lower eyelid surgery from ₹30,000 (as per requirement) by Dr. Ankit Bhalothia (Jaipur)

## Guides
- [FUE vs DHI Hair Transplant: Which Is Right for You?](https://www.kezza.co.in/blog/fue-vs-dhi-hair-transplant/): FUE and DHI take grafts the same way; they differ in how grafts are implanted. Compare density, shaving, session size and recovery, and who each suits.
- [Hair Transplant Cost in Jaipur: What Determines the Price](https://www.kezza.co.in/blog/hair-transplant-cost-jaipur/): What decides the cost of a hair transplant in Jaipur: graft count, technique, donor supply, sessions and aftercare, and how to compare quotes safely.
- [PRP vs GFC Therapy for Hair Loss: A Clinical Comparison](https://www.kezza.co.in/blog/prp-vs-gfc-therapy/): PRP and GFC both use growth factors from your own blood to treat thinning hair. How they differ in preparation, comfort, sessions and evidence.
- [How Many PRP Sessions Do You Need for Hair Loss?](https://www.kezza.co.in/blog/how-many-prp-sessions/): Most people start with 3 to 4 PRP sessions about a month apart, then maintenance every 3 to 6 months. What changes the number, and when to expect results.
- [Why Laser Can't Remove White Hair, and What Does](https://www.kezza.co.in/blog/why-laser-cant-remove-white-hair/): Laser hair reduction needs pigment to work, so white and grey hairs don't respond. How electrolysis treats them one follicle at a time, and what to expect.
- [The Norwood Scale Explained: 7 Stages of Male Pattern Hair Loss](https://www.kezza.co.in/blog/norwood-scale-explained/): What each Norwood stage looks like, how doctors use the scale, and which treatments are usually considered at each stage of male pattern hair loss.
- [How Many Grafts Do You Need for a Hair Transplant?](https://www.kezza.co.in/blog/how-many-grafts-hair-transplant/): Estimate follicular graft counts by Norwood stage, hairline design, and donor density. Clinical guide from Kezza Hair & Skin Clinic doctors.
- [Hair Transplant Recovery Timeline: Day 1 to Month 12](https://www.kezza.co.in/blog/hair-transplant-recovery-timeline/): A stage-by-stage recovery timeline after hair transplant surgery: swelling, shedding, shock loss, dormancy, and final growth milestones.
- [Acne Scar Treatment Options: Types, Lasers & Peels](https://www.kezza.co.in/blog/acne-scars-treatment-options/): Compare clinical treatments for rolling, boxcar, and ice-pick acne scars: MNRF, fractional CO2 lasers, subcision, and TCA cross peels.
- [Hydra Facial Treatment: Steps, Benefits & Suitability](https://www.kezza.co.in/blog/hydrafacial-benefits-process/): What happens during a medical hydra facial: the cleansing, peel, extraction and serum steps, who it suits, how often to have it and how to look after your skin.
- [Laser Hair Reduction: How It Works & Sessions Needed](https://www.kezza.co.in/blog/laser-hair-removal-how-it-works/): How diode and Alexandrite lasers target hair follicles during the anagen growth phase. Session intervals, skin suitability, and results.
- [Chemical Peels for Pigmentation: Types, Benefits & Results](https://www.kezza.co.in/blog/chemical-peels-vs-laser-toning/): Dermatological guide to chemical peels for hyperpigmentation, melasma, and sun damage. Discover AHA, BHA, and TCA peels, peeling stages, and safety.
- [Cryolipolysis Fat Freezing: How It Works, Results & Safety](https://www.kezza.co.in/blog/cryolipolysis-fat-freezing-guide/): Evidence-based guide to cryolipolysis fat freezing. How cold-induced apoptosis reduces stubborn fat pockets, Indian BMI suitability, side effects, and results.
- [Body Sculpting vs Fat Loss: Key Differences](https://www.kezza.co.in/blog/body-sculpting-vs-weight-loss/): Understand why non-surgical body contouring is for localized fat reduction, not obesity management. Candidate criteria and clinical goals.
- [Microblading vs Powder Brows: Technique & Skin Type](https://www.kezza.co.in/blog/microblading-vs-powder-brows/): Compare hair-stroke microblading with shaded powder brows. Discover which technique suits oily skin, longevity, healing, and touch-ups.
- [Lip Blush Treatment: Procedure, Healing & Results](https://www.kezza.co.in/blog/lip-blush-treatment-guide/): Everything about semi-permanent lip blush: dark lip neutralization, pigment selection, healing stages, longevity, and aftercare rules.
- [Hair Transplant Hairline Design: How Doctors Plan the Front](https://www.kezza.co.in/blog/hair-transplant-hairline-design/): Learn how hair transplant doctors plan the frontal hairline using facial proportions, existing hair, donor supply, age and long-term hair-loss patterns.
- [What Happens During a Hair Transplant? A Step-by-Step Guide](https://www.kezza.co.in/blog/hair-transplant-procedure-day/): A practical guide to the main stages of a hair transplant, from consultation and hairline marking to graft extraction, recipient preparation and aftercare.
- [IPL Cricketer Kamlesh Nagarkoti Chooses Kezza Clinic for PRP Hair Treatment](https://www.kezza.co.in/blog/kamlesh-nagarkoti-prp-treatment-kezza-jaipur/): IPL cricketer Kamlesh Nagarkoti chose Kezza Clinic in Jaipur for PRP hair therapy. Learn why athletes trust PRP and what the treatment involves.
